business: Hess Cafe (morning café inside Mamali bar, 70 Christopher St, West Village, NYC)
by_segment: Weekday commuter (works in Manhattan, uses the 1 train)
why_not: I'm only commuting two days a week and I already have my spot where they know my order and I'm out in two minutes. A new place with $7.50 dessert lattes and no reviews isn't worth risking a slow line on the mornings I'm actually rushing.
I already have my café; they know my order and I get a proper seat there. A $7.50 cheesecake matcha I'd have to drink standing at a subway exit isn't enough to pull me away.

I'd happily take a free sip of the plain matcha on my way to the 1 train, and naming the grade and farm is a good sign, but $7 for a plain matcha latte is past what I spend on a drink. The $7.50 dessert lattes aren't for me at all.

I'm only in the West Village some weekends, and $7.50 for a flavored latte is well past what I pay for a drink. The free matcha sips are weekday mornings only, so they don't help me, and from the street it looks like a bar that happens to be open, not somewhere I'd stop for coffee.

why_yes: It's right at my subway exit and they name the matcha's grade and farm, which almost nobody does, so I'd take the free sip and probably buy the plain matcha latte. The strawberry cheesecake stuff I'd try once at most; I don't need sugar bombs.
